children: A drug test performed on the captain of an Air India flight that experienced an incident on August 4 was non-negative, India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau said on Friday.

The preliminary report said that the flight control system detected loss of all three hydraulic systems on the Airbus plane while cruising, adding that the final report of the investigation will be published in due course.
